summary: Telesat Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting of shareholders held on June 3, 2026. Shareholders voted on two items: election of ten director nominees and appointment of Deloitte LLP as auditor. All director nominees were elected, and Deloitte was appointed. No special situation event occurred; this is a routine meeting results filing. The filing is a foreign private issuer report of AGM outcomes, equivalent to a domestic 8-K for meeting results.
